item.title: I Went to the Woods: The weight of waiting
item.description: I had arrived at the moment of fleeting clarity. The boat ramp ended where the bottom flattened and with 160 pounds of concrete, my skiff would not float clear of the trailer. I pushed to no avail. Do I back out, cut my losses and wait for the tide to continue to drop, pause, then rise? That would be two more hours. I was ready to get out to our lot and start some real construction on our remote cabin.

item.title: Orthodox Jewish women in Israel may now take a rabbinic exam, like men
item.description: Until now, only Orthodox Jewish men in Israel have been allowed to take exams to become rabbis. After a long campaign, women can now also take the test - but still can't become rabbis

item.title: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
item.description: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

item.title: Opportunities shrinking for too many young people, says major report on 'lost generation'
item.description: A report warns the number of 16 to 24-year-olds out of work, education or training is set to rise to 1.25 million by 2031.

item.title: Villas, cars and cash: Italy seizes dead Mafia mobster's millions
item.description: Police say the operation targeted the network of notorious late Sicilian mafia boss Matteo Messina Denaro.

item.title: Two more boys die in latest heatwave water deaths
